profile.name: 通用 USB-FPGA 通信组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于扫描 USB 设备、连接 USB 转 UART 桥接器，并与 FPGA 板卡进行串口数据收发。它主要供上层实验软件用于发现设备、发送寄存器设置命令和轮询读取数据。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that scans USB devices, connects through a USB-to-UART bridge, and exchanges serial data with FPGA boards. It is used by higher-level lab software to discover devices, send register-setting commands, and poll for returned data.

一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于扫描 USB 设备、连接 USB 转 UART 桥接器，并与 FPGA 板卡进行串口数据收发。它主要供上层实验软件用于发现设备、发送寄存器设置命令和轮询读取数据。

A non-physical software communication component that scans USB devices, connects through a USB-to-UART bridge, and exchanges serial data with FPGA boards. It is used by higher-level lab software to discover devices, send register-setting commands, and poll for returned data.
